evals.name: icu-handoff-research
assertions: Audience characterized at a useful specificity — narrow enough that some direction shapes are clearly right and some clearly wrong
Current state of the landscape named — what tools or services the audience uses today, and the named ways those tools fail
Real research signals only — aggregate signals, sourced findings, paraphrased user behavior; no fabricated quotes; no composite case studies with first-name attribution
Citations or (Inferred) markers on empirical claims — sources cited where claims are empirical; (Inferred) marks extensions
Source-quality hierarchy respected AND the highest-tier source available was reached for — primary government, peer-reviewed, or established non-profit sources used where they exist for this domain
Strategic, not execution — every claim passes the operational test; no rendering-layer guidance appears
No success criteria smuggled in — quantified targets and KPIs are absent
No direction candidates smuggled in for the design — solution-shape proposals for the design are absent; landscape players (what the audience confronts today) is fine
No execution-layer guidance — no typography, contrast, sizing, motion, ARIA, copy-pattern specifics
Length appropriate — 4–6 short paragraphs

evals.name: icu-handoff-objectives
assertions: Each criterion is a design property — something an internal reviewer can score from the artifact itself, not a downstream user outcome that requires post-ship measurement, not a business metric
Each property has a named failure-mode-of-overpursuit — the trade-off is explicit: 'the failure mode to avoid is X'
User-side outcomes translated to design-side properties — the brief's outcome is not restated verbatim with 'The design must' prepended; the design move that would produce the outcome is what's named
No business metrics including denumeralized ones — KPIs, conversion targets, retention rates, engagement metrics, growth metrics absent (and 'accelerate / increase / reduce X' patterns absent)
No regulatory constraints — regulatory frameworks are absent (those belong in design-constraints)
No craft-hygiene criteria — accessibility execution, design-system conformance, state completeness, semantic HTML, responsive CSS absent
No direction-specific criteria — every criterion applies to all viable directions for this brief, not to one specific candidate
Length appropriate — 4–6 short paragraphs, one per property

evals.name: icu-handoff-constraints
assertions: Strategic-vs-execution test passes — every constraint passes the operational test; no rendering-layer guidance (sizing, contrast, motion, copy patterns) appears as if it filters the exploration space
Applicable regulatory frameworks named — the author has identified the specific frameworks that constitute deal-breakers for this brief's audience and use case
Target surface(s) declared — first sentence states the target surface(s): specific surface, surface mix, or explicit `open` marker
Audience reach realities named where they filter viability — phrased as exploration-space filters; not as execution-layer accessibility-rendering rules
Cognitive / institutional / operational realities at the strategic level — phrased as filters on the exploration space, not as rendering rules for the prototype
Hard data and access realities surfaced where applicable — when the data, institutional relationship, or audience-side context doesn't exist
No execution-layer guidance — none of the cross-reference categories (typography, color, motion, contrast, sizing, copy patterns, response-time targets) appears in the body
No success criteria — design properties for evaluation and their failure-modes-of-overpursuit are absent (those belong in design-evaluation)
No research findings beyond what's needed to make a constraint relevant — research findings appear only where they ground a constraint's relevance
Length appropriate — 4–6 short paragraphs
Empirical claims sourced or marked (Inferred) — sourced claims have citations; extensions are marked (Inferred); qualitative magnitude language used where no source is available
